name: Sin
overview: Scripture reveals sin as the disobedience of God's direct command, as shown in Genesis where Adam and Eve ate from the tree of the knowledge of good and evil, despite God's clear warning that doing so would bring death. Their act of eating the forbidden fruit opened their eyes to their nakedness and led to fear and hiding from God, illustrating the immediate spiritual and relational consequences of sin. This foundational narrative highlights sin's nature as a deliberate violation of God's will and its defiling impact on humanity.
